title: The generated Spring /login endpoint is gone (fail-closed, no session minted) and one wrong password at /rest/saiku/session counts once against the login budget

criteria.then: the generated Spring "Please sign in" page is no longer served: the request is refused (401/403/404), never 200
no authentication happens: the request is refused (401/403/404), never a 302 that mints a session

criteria.given: four wrong passwords for one user posted to /rest/saiku/session
criteria.then: each attempt answers 401 — one failure is recorded per attempt, so the budget of 5 is not exhausted on the fourth

criteria.given: the fifth wrong password for that user (the budget's last attempt)
criteria.then: it still answers 401, and only the next attempt for the same user answers 429

steps.name: the generated sign-in page is not served

expect.because: the main security chain no longer registers form login or the generated /login page; a fail-closed 401 is the terminal catch-all answer

steps.name: posting credentials to /login does not authenticate

expect.because: no form-login filter exists any more, so a credential POST to /login must never mint a session or redirect to /

steps.name: four wrong passwords each answer 401 — failures count once per attempt

expect.because: the documented (client IP, username) budget is 5; with single counting the fourth wrong password is still a plain 401

steps.name: the fifth wrong password is the last one the budget allows

expect.because: five single-counted failures exhaust the budget exactly; the lockout must not trip early

steps.name: the budget is exhausted: the next attempt for that user is locked out

expect.because: after the five-attempt budget is spent the account stays locked until the window ends, whatever password is presented
